note: Initial deliberately generous baseline, measured 2026-08-11 with a ReleaseFast boris on Apple silicon (arm64-darwin) over the pinned 1k-page corpus. The gate multiplies each phase by BORIS_BENCHMARK_FACTOR (default 2.0) and fails when a measured phase exceeds that bound. Refresh when host-class or corpus assumptions change: run 'BORIS_BENCHMARK_UPDATE_BASELINE=1 zig build benchmark' and commit the rewritten file.
